usedFor: Copper holds your people and leads, and 2Chat gets them as contacts through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person” in Copper, then “Create Contact” in 2Chat
bestTemplate.why: A person added to Copper is copied into 2Chat as a contact with their details.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs at least one of phone, email or address, so a lead without any will not copy.
